# Identify the series number of the episode titled "The Weekend Aunt Helen Came"
# Use case-insensitive matching and strip quotes/spaces for comparison
target_series_num = df.loc[df['Title'].str.lower().str.strip('" ') == 'the weekend aunt helen came', 'Series #'].iloc[0]

# Filter episodes where the series number is strictly greater than the target series number
later_episodes = df[df['Series #'] > target_series_num]

# Count the number of such episodes
answer = len(later_episodes)
